FUNCTION RemovePunctuation(sentence):
    punctuation_set <- CALL to_set(CALL list_value(STRING("."), STRING(","), STRING("!"), STRING("?"), STRING(";"), STRING(":"), STRING("-"), STRING("'"), STRING("\""), STRING("("), STRING(")")))
    clean_sentence <- EMPTY STRING
    
    FOR EACH char IN sentence DO
        IF char NOT IN punctuation_set THEN
            clean_sentence <- clean_sentence + char
        END IF
    END FOR
    
    RETURN clean_sentence
END FUNCTION
